Brand.name: Facility Hub
Brand.tagline: Maintenance and cleaning services across Omantel facilities

Home.title: A Better Workplace Starts Here
Home.description: Your seamless connection to maintenance and cleaning services across Omantel facilities.
Home.servicesSubtitle: Choose a service. We'll guide you step by step, and it takes about a minute.
Home.maintenanceText: Report facility issues and help us keep your workplace safe and comfortable.
Home.cleaningText: Request cleaning support and help maintain a fresh, welcoming environment.
Home.quickMyText: Follow every request in real time
Home.quickQrText: Start a request from the code on site
Home.quickMapText: Find a place and report from the map
Home.quickGuideText: What we cover and what to expect
Home.recentEmpty: You haven't submitted any requests yet.
Home.signInPrompt: Sign in to see your requests and their progress.
Home.buildingTitle: Designed around the places you work
Home.buildingText: From the basement car parks to the meeting rooms and event spaces, every request is routed to the right Facility Operations team with its exact location.
Home.step1Text: Pick the floor and area, or scan the QR code on site.
Home.step2Text: A short description and a photo help the team arrive prepared.
Home.step3Text: Get e-mail updates and confirm when the issue is resolved.
Home.safetyTitle: In an emergency, don't wait for a ticket
Home.safetyText: Smoke, exposed wiring, water near electricity, blocked exits or someone trapped in a lift: contact building security or emergency services first, through the verified channels in your building.
Home.qrHint: Point your camera at the Facility Hub code on site.
Home.qrUnsupported: This browser can't scan codes here. Open your phone's camera app and point it at the code instead.
Home.qrDenied: Camera access was blocked. Allow the camera, or use your phone's camera app.
Home.qrInvalid: This isn't a Facility Hub location code.

Footer.about: An internal Omantel platform for facility maintenance and cleaning requests. Not for IT, network, software or audio-visual support.
Footer.itNote: IT, computer, network and audio-visual issues are handled by IT support, not Facility Hub.

PriorityHelp.LOW: Cosmetic or can wait a few days
PriorityHelp.MEDIUM: Affects comfort or work, not urgent
PriorityHelp.HIGH: Disrupts work or may cause damage
PriorityHelp.EMERGENCY: Immediate risk to people or the building

Fields.meetingRoomPh: As shown on the door sign

Wizard.title: New request
Wizard.serviceHelp: Facility services only. For computers, network, software or audio-visual equipment please contact IT support.
Wizard.locationHelp: Choose the floor and area. You can add exact details below.
Wizard.fromQr: Location filled in from the QR code. You can change it.
Wizard.fromMap: Location chosen on the building map. You can change it.
Wizard.otherLocationPh: Building, floor and the nearest landmark
Wizard.problemHelp: Options are based on the area you chose.
Wizard.descriptionPh: What happened, since when, and anything the team should know before arriving.
Wizard.descriptionHint: Example: "Two ceiling lights flicker near column C-14, worse in the evening."
Wizard.photosHelp: Up to {max} photos, {size} MB each (JPG, PNG or WebP). Photos are optional but help a lot.
Wizard.reviewHelp: Check the details. You'll get a reference number and e-mail updates.
Wizard.successText: Facility Operations has received your request. We've e-mailed you a confirmation.
Wizard.chooseIssue: Choose a problem, or describe it under "Something else".
Wizard.noAreas: No areas are configured for this floor yet. Choose "Other" or another floor.
Wizard.noIssues: No predefined problems for this area. Describe it under "Something else".

Safety.title: This may be an emergency
Safety.text: If there is smoke, a burning smell, exposed wiring, water near electrical equipment, a blocked emergency exit or someone trapped in an elevator, contact building security or emergency services immediately through your building's verified channels. Do not rely on this online request.
Safety.noContact: Use the emergency numbers posted in your building.
Safety.acknowledge: I've contacted security / it's not an emergency. Continue

Guide.title: Services Guide
Guide.subtitle: What Facility Hub covers, and how requests are handled.

Guide.areasText: Only locations confirmed by Facility Operations are listed. Use "Other" when your location isn't listed yet.

config.locationsHelp: Building → Wing → Floor → Area. Only verified locations should be added. Employees see active items only.
config.categoriesHelp: Categories and the problems employees can pick. Area types and floors decide where each problem is offered.
config.teamsHelp: Contractors can only receive requests after their scope is confirmed.
config.members: {count, plural, =0 {No members} one {# member} other {# members}}
config.routingHelp: The first active rule that matches a request (top to bottom) suggests its team. With auto-assign, the request is assigned on submission.
config.slaHelp: Targets per priority. Leave empty for no target. Values marked "Sample" are development placeholders, not approved commitments.
config.emergencyHelp: Shown in the safety warning. Leave empty until Facility Operations provides a verified number.
config.emailsHelp: Variables: {vars}. E-mails are queued and sent in the background.
config.mapsHelp: Upload an approved floor plan (PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG), place markers and draw zones, then publish. Unpublished maps are never shown to employees.
config.zoneHint: Click to add corners, then Finish zone.
config.pointHint: Click on the plan to place a marker.
config.qrHelp: Each code opens the request form with the location filled in. Codes contain only a random token.
config.regenerateConfirm: Old printed codes for this area will stop working. Continue?
config.usersHelp: Users are created automatically on first Microsoft sign-in. Assign roles here. Contractors only see requests for their team.
